item.title: CHURCH Tries to Shut Down MARILYN MANSON in Mexico: 'Mocks Faith, Promotes Evil'
item.description: Marilyn Manson is scheduled to perform at the FENAPO, the National Fair of San Luis Potosí, on August 10 at the Teatro del Pueblo, with free admission. However, the Catholic Church tried to shut it down.

item.title: Sick New World 2025 Lineup Announced: Metallica, Linkin Park & More
item.description: Sick New World 2025 is coming in hard, and this lineup is anything but subtle. Let’s cut to the chase—Metallica and Linkin Park are headlining. What? Metallica showing up at a festival that usually leans nü-metal?
